name: What is the process for planning accessible appliance placement with a contractor?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for planning accessible appliance placement with a contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process typically begins with an initial consultation to discuss your specific needs, preferences, and the existing layout of your home. Our contractor will conduct a site visit to take measurements and assess feasibility. Based on this, a detailed design proposal will be developed, outlining appliance placement, necessary modifications, and material selections. Once approved, we handle permit applications and proceed with construction and installation, ensuring all work meets accessibility standards and your expectations. Regular communication is maintained throughout the project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Planning starts with a consultation and site visit to assess needs. A detailed design proposal is created, followed by permits, construction, and installation, with ongoing communication.
